say:2:1013401001:2.text: Lucius, can we swap positions? I'll take the rear.
say:2:1013401001:2.source_cn: ——卢修斯，我们换个位置吧。我来殿后。

say:3:1013401002:1.text: Now look what you've done, guys! Stop making Temesia so uncomfortable with your gossiping!
say:3:1013401002:1.source_cn: 啊，好的。拜托你们几个，讲别人的事情能不能别那么大声——！！

say:5:1013401003:3.text: Thanks, Lucius. Now people miles away can hear you yelling.
say:5:1013401003:3.source_cn: 卢修斯，多谢你，现在几十里外的镇民也能听清楚了。

say:7:1013401004:2.source_cn: ……艾雅在上，特弥希娅，我很抱歉……

choice_prompt:8:1013401004.source_cn: ……艾雅在上，特弥希娅，我很抱歉……

say:9:1013401005:2.text: The Ancient Battlefield is still quite a distance. It probably would be smart to rest before we travel the rest of the way.
say:9:1013401005:2.source_cn: 嗯……距傀儡古战场还有些距离，恐怕不能一鼓作气地赶到那里。

say:10:1013401006:1.text: I know there's a camp up ahead. Let's take a breather there.
say:10:1013401006:1.source_cn: 我知道前方有块营地，先在那里歇歇脚吧。

choice:8:1:2.text: Let's find a place to rest.
choice:8:1:2.male: Let's find a place to rest.
choice:8:1:2.female: Let's find a place to rest.

say:0:1013402001:0.text: You guys go start a fire; I'll go find some firewood.

say:5:1013404004:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, correct me if I'm wrong.
say:5:1013404004:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, correct me if I'm wrong.
say:5:1013404004:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, correct me if I'm wrong.

say:6:1013404005:1.text: You seem to have quite a history with her and... even received some of her goodwill.

say:6:1013404005:1.male: You seem to have quite a history with her and... even received some of her goodwill.
say:6:1013404005:1.female: You seem to have quite a history with her and... even received some of her goodwill.

say:7:1013404006:1.text: I trust your judgment, so when you suggested traveling with her, I didn't voice my objections.

say:1:1013406001:1.source_cn: 特弥希娅跟阿塔兰忒的事？对艾雅发誓，我什么都不知道！

say:2:1013406002:1.text: I've been partnered with Temesia for quite a while. Back then, she'd been sent to Oakenfell because of a bad investigation.
say:2:1013406002:1.source_cn: 我跟特弥希娅搭档，照理说也有些年头了。那时，特弥希娅因...

say:4:1013406004:1.text: Temesia holds herself to high standards and isn't exactly close to anyone. I genuinely want to look out for her! But it seems to backfire every time...

choice_prompt:5:1013406004.text: Temesia holds herself to high standards and isn't exactly close to anyone. I genuinely want to look out for her! But it seems to backfire every time...

say:6:1013406005:1.text: But I can do better! Hmm. Let me think about Temesia's past...
say:6:1013406005:1.source_cn: 别说这种话。我也想帮上忙！让我想想，特弥希娅过去的事……

say:7:1013406006:1.text: Um... Temesia's past... Oh! I just remembered something—
say:7:1013406006:1.source_cn: 呃……特弥希娅过去的事……对了！我想到了一个——

say:8:1013406007:1.text: You'd never guess this, but she used to lead the choir when she was young! But those days are long gone...
say:8:1013406007:1.source_cn: 这个你肯定不知道，她小时候是唱诗班的领唱！不过，她现在...

say:8:1013406007:1.female: You'd never guess this, but she used to lead the choir when she was young! But those days are long gone...

say:9:1013406008:1.text: When she first became a knight, she wasn't as reserved and serious as she is now.
say:9:1013406008:1.source_cn: 刚成为骑士那时候，特弥希娅可不像现在这样，活似壁画上不...

say:10:1013406009:1.text: As her senior, I remember her being quite loud back then, always striving to keep up with training, and she was closer to everyone than she is now.
say:10:1013406009:1.source_cn: 你也知道，我是她的前辈。还记得那时候，她说话声音很大，...
say:10:1013406009:1.male: As her senior, I remember her being quite loud back then, always striving to keep up with training, and she was closer to everyone than she is now.
say:10:1013406009:1.female: As her senior, I remember her being quite loud back then, always striving to keep up with training, and she was closer to everyone than she is now.

say:11:1013406010:1.text: I can't exactly remember when she began changing... Temesia started talking less and began distancing herself from everyone.
say:11:1013406010:1.source_cn: 是从什么时候开始，变成现在这样的呢……特弥希娅开始话少...

say:12:1013406011:1.text: Perhaps it was around the time she was tasked with investigating the whereabouts of the Faith Stone?
say:12:1013406011:1.source_cn: 似乎就是她受命追查圣石下落前后？

choice:5:0:1.text: I'm sure you tried your best.
choice:5:0:1.male: I'm sure you tried your best.
choice:5:0:1.female: I'm sure you tried your best.

say:0:1013407001:0.source_cn: 各位聊什么呢？不如带我一个？

say:1:1013408001:1.text: ... At the end of the day, you can only rely on yourself. Right?

say:3:1013408002:2.text: Is that really how you feel? I've seen you getting attention wherever you go. I almost thought you were the type who's always "all smiles". But well...
say:3:1013408002:2.source_cn: 你真的这么想？看到你无论在哪里都是前呼后拥，我还以为你...

say:4:1013408003:1.text: You asked me to be your guide, and yet you were still double-checking the map...
say:4:1013408003:1.source_cn: 我刚才都看到了。你明明拜托了我带路，却还不放心地掏出地...

say:4:1013408003:1.female: You asked me to be your guide, and yet you were still double-checking the map...

say:5:1013408004:1.text: It's really disheartening. You don't even trust me this much? Even after I lent you a hand in the Dark Forest.
say:5:1013408004:1.source_cn: 真让人伤心。就这么不信任我？我好歹也在薄暮丛林帮过你们。

say:7:1013408006:1.text: ...Please trust me. No matter what doubts you have or what you've heard, it's better not to hastily conclude that I'm unforgivable...
say:7:1013408006:1.source_cn: ……相信我吧。无论你在怀疑什么，无论你听到了什么，最好...

say:1:1013410001:1.source_cn: 夜已经深了，旧日的路标最近被魔偶毁了，我得去探探路，才...

say:2:1013410002:1.text: Oh, but—you guys aren't confident in letting me explore alone, huh?
say:2:1013410002:1.source_cn: 让我看看——喂，你们也不放心让我一个人去探路吧？

say:4:1013410003:2.text: Especially you, Temesia. The way you're looking at me, it's like I'm about to bring back a bunch of bandits to attack here.
say:4:1013410003:2.source_cn: 尤其是特弥希娅。你的眼神，好像我正准备着带回一大帮匪徒...

say:5:1013410004:2.text: You should remember that I never wanted you to guide us on this journey.
say:5:1013410004:2.source_cn: 你应该记得，让你担任向导与我们同行，这从来不是我的意思。

say:6:1013410005:1.text: But now... since <style="stress"><player_name></style> has accepted you as a companion, I feel responsible for keeping an eye on you.
say:6:1013410005:1.male: But now... since <style="stress"><player_name></style> has accepted you as a companion, I feel responsible for keeping an eye on you.
say:6:1013410005:1.female: But now... since <style="stress"><player_name></style> has accepted you as a companion, I feel responsible for keeping an eye on you.

say:7:1013410006:0.text: I bet looking at me is the last thing you wanna do, huh?
say:7:1013410006:0.source_cn: 我还以为，你很讨厌把目光落在我身上呢。

say:8:1013410007:1.text: It's unfortunate, but I have to. Because I'm more aware than anyone else here... that you're not to be trusted.
say:8:1013410007:1.source_cn: 很遗憾我不得不如此。因为我比在场的任何人……都更清楚你...

choice_prompt:9:1013410007.text: It's unfortunate, but I have to. Because I'm more aware than anyone else here... that you're not to be trusted.
choice_prompt:9:1013410007.source_cn: 很遗憾我不得不如此。因为我比在场的任何人……都更清楚你不可信任。

say:12:1013410009:2.text: I'll keep an eye on her. We'll be back shortly.
say:12:1013410009:2.source_cn: 我会看着她的，我们去去就回。

say:15:1013410010:1.text: Ahhh, I really wish I could join them.

say:17:1013410011:1.text: *Laughter* You just want to be part of the drama, don't you, Valen?
say:17:1013410011:1.source_cn: 你是想去看戏吧，维伦。收敛一点好奇心吧！

narration:19:1013410012:0.text: Atalanta and Temesia went ahead to explore, but they didn't return even after a whole night...
narration:19:1013410012:0.source_cn: 阿塔兰忒和特弥希娅前去探路，但一夜未归……

choice:9:1:2.text: Why don't you both go together?
choice:9:1:2.male: Why don't you both go together?
choice:9:1:2.female: Why don't you both go together?

say:0:1013411001:0.text: They haven't returned yet. If they ran into danger...
say:0:1013411001:0.source_cn: 她们还没回来，要是遇到危险……

say:1:1013411002:0.text: I believe Temesia can handle herself! But if, uh, something tricky happens to her...
say:1:1013411002:0.source_cn: 我相信特弥希娅有实力对抗险情！但是万一她……呃，被算计……

say:2:1013411003:0.text: Shall we go and look for them?

say:0:1013412001:0.female: Magister Merlin, so who exactly is Atalanta?

say:1:1013412002:0.text: When we were ambushed in the Dark Forest, Atalanta appeared and saved us.
